parameter_notes.depth_status: Default assumed rectangular mean depth; no bathymetry. Per-feature cross_sections override it where supplied.
parameter_notes.exchange_status: Illustrative Newton coefficient; not inherited or calibrated from legacy cooling_seconds.

hydraulics.bank_slope_status: authored_illustrative_not_measured; override with --bank-slope when surveyed valley profiles exist
hydraulics.dispersion_context: Fischer D per cell is an order-of-magnitude check on the illustrative dispersion_m2_s, not a fitted value
hydraulics.slope: reach-averaged grade per river feature (total elevation drop / total length); cell-scale drops are vertex noise, not energy slope; flat/adverse grades leave Manning undefined
hydraulics.solver_volumes: rectangular length*width*depth (baseline preserved); trapezoid area/volume reported per cell as diagnostic with rectangular_bias_pct

parameter_notes.initial_condition: Calculated steady state at t=0 forcing.
parameter_notes.omitted_tributaries: Only explicitly configured ecosystem lateral flows are included. Mapped streams do not supply invented discharge.

simulation_time.scheduled_forcing: Right-continuous piecewise-constant Series; the integration splits at forcing changes.

parameter_notes.surface_budget: Not used; lumped Newton exchange only.
parameter_notes.weather: Diurnal approximation or a scheduled air_temperature_c, sampled every 60 physical seconds; not date-specific meteorology.
parameter_notes.width: Authored width from world.json; not surveyed banks.
